original.target_description: Experiment 4b: 24 native French-speaking undergraduates, four Target × Digit Combination groups; recognition-test correct responses, initial mixed ANOVA main effect of dependency type (adjacent versus nonadjacent), with digit combination and target as between-subjects factors. Computer-paced digit presentation.

n.sample_role: Participants in Experiment 4b recognition-test ANOVA; four groups of 6. The reported F(1, 20) and accompanying t(23) tests are consistent with all 24 participants.

notes:
Replication values are supplied/derived by primary project authors, extracted without conversion. Table character encoding is cp1252; effect metric glyphs preserved as supplied. N (R) is not assumed to be analytic n. 
Source follow-up: Original-only blind validation. Source title, authors, year and DOI match the supplied reference. Source version: published article supplied by licensed EBSCO PsycInfo service. Locator p. 12 matches PDF p. 12, published p. 91. Quotes preserve extraction glyphs; line breaks and intercolumn whitespace normalized. The target is the dependency-type main effect, not either chance-level t test or the separate familiar-versus-transfer ANOVA. Replication and reported_success were not examined, as required.
